title: [Bug] Chat history scrolling not accessible, content truncated
body:
**Bug Description**
scroll is broken. the chat history is cut off and not accessible

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: windsurf
- Version: 2.1.89
- Feedback ID: 4a034183-94ab-42af-a131-697679ff5b45
author: mleos-smartunex

top_comments.author: DarrenLyons
top_comments.body: Same issue in VSC. Confirmed it's not auto-compaction or terminal buffer/scrollback settings. It's the CLI aggressively pruning messages.

top_comments.author: lukemmtt
top_comments.body: Same as https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/42670; yours was filed first, but might as well upvote both though?

top_comments.author: claude[bot]
top_comments.body: This is a duplicate of #41814, which was fixed as of version 2.1.101.
